key.name: catalog
key.description: Every known sensor by category, with its order and last reading, whether each category is switched on, and the sensors in the panel. Described in docs/catalog-design.md.

key.name: update-time
key.description: How often sensors are read. Only sensors on screen are read: those in the top bar and in the open menu. The preferences offer 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 seconds.

key.name: position-in-panel
key.description: Where Vitals sits in the top bar. 0=left, 1=center, 2=right, 3=far left, 4=far right

key.name: allow-panel-dragging
key.summary: Reorder panel sensors by drag and drop
key.description: Reorder panel sensors by dragging them

key.name: use-higher-precision
key.description: Show one extra digit after decimal

key.name: include-aggregates
key.description: Show the average, minimum and maximum over the temperatures and over the fans as rows of their own, below the sensors

key.name: hide-zeros
key.description: Exclude temperature sensors that read zero during discovery. Retry excluded sensors on rediscovery; accept later zeros from admitted sensors.

key.name: unit
key.description: The unit ('centigrade' or 'fahrenheit') the extension should display the temperature in

key.name: network-hardware-only
key.description: Leave the interfaces that are not hardware, such as bridges, container and VPN interfaces and the loopback, out of the network menu. The network totals are over the hardware interfaces either way.

key.name: include-public-ip
key.description: Display public IP address of internet connection

key.name: network-public-ip-interval
key.summary: Public IP refresh interval in minutes

key.name: network-public-ip-show-flag
key.summary: Show country flag for public IP

key.name: network-public-ip-provider
key.description: Service used to look up public IP address. 0=Core Coding, 1=MyIP.com, 2=ipify

key.name: network-speed-format
key.description: Should speed display in bits or bytes?

key.name: network-speed-unit
key.description: Fix the network speed unit instead of auto-scaling. 0=Auto, 1=Kbps or KB/s, 2=Mbps or MB/s

key.name: storage-path
key.description: Storage path for monitoring

key.name: memory-measurement
key.description: Can use gigabyte or gibibyte for memory

key.name: storage-measurement
key.description: Can use gigabyte or gibibyte for storage

key.name: battery-slot
key.description: Which numerical battery slot should vitals monitor

key.name: fixed-widths
key.description: Keep room for a value's widest text, so its neighbours do not jump. The room is given back after a minute.

key.name: emphasize-values
key.description: Draw icons and units in the top bar lighter and smaller than the numbers

key.name: hide-icons
key.description: Keep top bar clean by only showing sensor values

key.name: menu-centered
key.description: Open the menu centered under the sensors in the top bar. Otherwise it is centered under the pointer.

key.name: monitor-cmd
key.description: The command run when system monitor button is clicked

key.name: include-static-info
key.description: Display processor static information that doesn't change

key.name: include-static-gpu-info
key.description: Display GPU static information that doesn't change

key.name: icon-style
key.description: Set the style for the displayed sensor icons (0=original, 1=gnome)

key.name: temperature-colors
key.description: Color rules matched against the displayed temperature value. Entries are "threshold r g b" for all sensors, or "threshold r g b sensor:<category>/<key>" for one sensor. Multiple sensors may each have their own breakpoints; unknown sensor keys are ignored.

key.name: fan-colors
key.description: Color rules matched against fan RPM. Entries are "threshold r g b" or "threshold r g b sensor:<category>/<key>" per sensor. Unknown sensor keys are ignored.

key.name: memory-colors
key.description: Color rules matched against memory usage percentage. Entries are "threshold r g b" or "threshold r g b sensor:<category>/<key>". Unknown sensor keys are ignored.

key.name: processor-colors
key.description: Color rules matched against processor usage percentage. Entries are "threshold r g b" or "threshold r g b sensor:<category>/<key>". Unknown sensor keys are ignored.

key.name: system-colors
key.description: Color rules matched against system load average. Entries are "threshold r g b" or "threshold r g b sensor:<category>/<key>". Unknown sensor keys are ignored.

key.name: battery-colors
key.description: Color rules matched against battery percentage. Entries are "threshold r g b" or "threshold r g b sensor:<category>/<key>". Unknown sensor keys are ignored.

key.name: gpu-colors
key.description: Color rules matched against GPU utilization percentages. Entries are "threshold r g b" or "threshold r g b sensor:<category>/<key>". Unknown sensor keys are ignored.
